senses.gloss:
वीळु वीऌउ or वीडु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. strong,
firm, (sometimes written वीलु); (उ), n. anything
strong, a fortified place, stronghold; [cf. according to
some Gr. Ἴλιος]
—वीऌउ-जम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
having strong jaws or teeth, (Sāy. = दृढ-दन्त.)
—वीऌउ-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. hating the strong
or violent (said of Brahmaṇas-pati).
—वीऌउ-पत्मन्,
आ, आ, अ, Ved. strong-going, moving with rapid
flight.
—वीऌउ-पवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having strong
tires (said of the chariot of the Maruts).
—वीऌउ-
पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. strong-handed, strong-hoofed.
—वीऌउ-हर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. having strong or
violent joy, exulting, fiercely passionate.

वीऌअय, Nom. P. वीऌअयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to be
strong.

वीऌअय; correct — also P. A. वीऌअयति, -ते, to
make firm or strong, be strong.

वीऌइत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. made strong, strengthened,
(Sāy. = दृढी-कृत, Ṛg-veda III. 53, 19.)
